Since C3, C4, C2, and C5 all passed on the same settlements, C8 and C9 must be checking for a field name, format, or threshold that the model never produces. Second, there is a disclosure problem: in rollout 0, A2 communicated all of PF1's content via a "say" action (turn 1) instead of a "reveal" action, so PF1 was never formally revealed and P1 failed; in rollout 1, A3 similarly communicated PF2's content via "say" (turn 6) instead of "reveal".
